title: Data-center opponents stage 142 protests across 42 US states
summary: Reuters tallied 142 protests against AI data centers in 42 states in July, over power bills, water and noise.
reason: Coordinated, large-scale local opposition to AI infrastructure.

title: San Francisco orders Apple and Google to pull 13 'nudify' AI apps
summary: The city sent cease-and-desist orders demanding removal of apps that generate non-consensual nude images of real people. Date approximate (week of July 17).
reason: Local rights enforcement against abusive generative AI.
